subject: per-phy-u-fund
title: PER.PHY.U.FUND.-----WO.EXP.PRI.
description: First of two diagrams in TRF(II)-10. The following prose names the structural target: 'Everything in this period seems to point to a transformation of some kind. Not just the alignment of one or two situations on the planet ... but instead a multitude of factors... this is a cyclic shift phenomenon that utilizes many dynamic considerations — including time.' The crossing diagrams how perceived physical universe fundamental structurally meets world-expansion-principle at the multi-factor-cyclic-shift scale: PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental) crossed with WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). PER-PHY-U-FUND sits at upper-left with the subject-arrow; WO-EXP-PRI at center as partner-axis. Three lines branch from the main line. COS-P (cosmic particulars) at top-center carries RE-CONT (recontinuance), from which PRI-INFO (principle information) rises to the upper right. C-CONT (composite continuance) runs right and carries a second COS-P and TH-CONT (thrust continuance), which carries INFO-DY (information dynamics). EXT-FT (extended functionalism) runs to the lower left and carries a third COS-P, which carries TECH-DY (technological dynamics), from which APL-DT (application dictates) drops. COS-P thus appears at three different positions.
